svg.title: Time to finish agent work, mlx-lm against Locals
svg.desc: 16 coding agents calling tools: mlx-lm 74.6 s, Locals 29.3 s. 40 LiveCodeBench problems: mlx-lm 19.7 min, Locals 7.93 min. 48 word problems: mlx-lm 183 s, Locals 63 s. Rewriting a 100-line file: mlx-lm 16.1 s, Locals 6.9 s. First request after a restart: mlx-lm 16.3 s, Locals 1.7 s.
